name: Reshmi Kabab
description: Soft Pakistani reshmi kabab made with finely minced chicken, cream, herbs and gentle spices, shaped on skewers and grilled.
method: Combine chicken mince with cream, yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, chilies, coriander and spices.
Add roasted gram flour and mix until the mixture becomes sticky enough to hold its shape.
With damp hands, shape the mixture around skewers.
Grill or cook in a lightly oiled grill pan, turning carefully until browned and fully cooked.
Serve hot with mint chutney, sliced onion and lemon.
